name: Nosleep
description:
Keep the machine awake: a Quick Settings toggle that blocks suspend and lid-switch sleep by holding a systemd-inhibit lock inside a transient systemd user unit.

The unit is the single source of truth — the toggle can never desync from the real inhibitor, it survives gnome-shell restarts, and it dies on logout so normal sleep behavior always comes back on its own. Scriptable from the terminal with the companion nosleep CLI (e.g. 'nosleep 2h').

Note: this blocks sleep, not idle — the screen may still blank or lock.
